"""整篇台本批量合成测试器：比较 F5（A 线）与 GPT-SoVITS（B 线）在真实风格台本上的表现。

输入：markdown 台本（取「## 正文（口播稿）」段落，按 **〔N、标题〕** 分节）。
输出：data/out/script_test/<engine>/sec<N>_full.wav（整节连播）+ chunks.jsonl（每段文本/时长/耗时）。

用法：
  python scripts/synth_script.py --script 台本.md --engine both            # 全节
  python scripts/synth_script.py --script 台本.md --engine f5 --sections 1,6
"""
import argparse, json, os, pathlib, re, sys, time

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
OUT_BASE = ROOT / "data" / "out" / "script_test"

# ---------- 台本解析 ----------

CN_NUM = {"一": 1, "二": 2, "三": 3, "四": 4, "五": 5, "六": 6, "七": 7, "八": 8, "九": 9, "十": 10}

def parse_script(path: pathlib.Path):
    """返回 [(sec_no, title, body_text)]，只取「正文（口播稿）」段。"""
    md = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(r"## 正文.*?\n(.*?)(?:\n---\n|\Z)", md, re.S)
    if not m:
        sys.exit("没找到「## 正文（口播稿）」段落")
    body = m.group(1)
    sections, cur_no, cur_title, cur_lines = [], None, None, []
    for line in body.splitlines():
        hm = re.match(r"\*\*〔([一二三四五六七八九十]+)、([^〕]+)〕\*\*", line.strip())
        if hm:
            if cur_no is not None:
                sections.append((cur_no, cur_title, "\n".join(cur_lines)))
            cur_no, cur_title, cur_lines = CN_NUM[hm.group(1)], hm.group(2).strip(), []
        elif cur_no is not None:
            cur_lines.append(line.strip().replace("**", ""))
    if cur_no is not None:
        sections.append((cur_no, cur_title, "\n".join(cur_lines)))
    out = []
    for no, title, text in sections:
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", "", text)  # 口播文本去掉所有空白
        if text:
            out.append((no, title, text))
    return out

def chunk_zh(text: str, max_chars=50):
    """按中文句末标点切句，贪心打包成 ≤max_chars 的合成块；超长句按逗号顿号再切。"""
    parts = [p for p in re.split(r"(?<=[。！？；…])", text) if p]
    units = []
    for p in parts:
        if len(p) > max_chars:
            units.extend([u for u in re.split(r"(?<=[，、——])", p) if u])
        else:
            units.append(p)
    chunks, buf = [], ""
    for u in units:
        if buf and len(buf) + len(u) > max_chars:
            chunks.append(buf)
            buf = u
        else:
            buf += u
    if buf:
        chunks.append(buf)
    return chunks

# ---------- A 线：F5-TTS-MLX（模型只加载一次） ----------

def run_f5(sections, ref_wav, ref_text_path, seed):
    os.environ.setdefault("HF_ENDPOINT", "https://hf-mirror.com")
    import re as _re
    import mlx.core as mx
    import numpy as np
    import soundfile as sf
    from f5_tts_mlx.cfm import F5TTS
    from f5_tts_mlx.utils import convert_char_to_pinyin

    SR, HOP, TARGET_RMS = 24_000, 256, 0.1
    ref_text = pathlib.Path(ref_text_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    audio, sr = sf.read(ref_wav)
    assert sr == SR, f"参考音频需 24kHz（当前 {sr}）"
    audio = mx.array(audio)
    rms = mx.sqrt(mx.mean(mx.square(audio)))
    if rms < TARGET_RMS:
        audio = audio * TARGET_RMS / rms
    ref_n = audio.shape[0]

    print("[f5] 加载模型…")
    model = F5TTS.from_pretrained("lucasnewman/f5-tts-mlx")

    def est_dur_sec(gen_text, speed=1.0):
        ref_len_frames = ref_n // HOP
        zh_punc = r"。，、；：？！"
        ref_len = len(ref_text.encode("utf-8")) + 3 * len(_re.findall(zh_punc, ref_text))
        gen_len = len(gen_text.encode("utf-8")) + 3 * len(_re.findall(zh_punc, gen_text))
        return (ref_len_frames + int(ref_len_frames / ref_len * gen_len / speed)) / (SR / HOP)

    out_dir = OUT_BASE / "f5"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rows = []
    for no, title, text in sections:
        chunks = chunk_zh(text)
        pieces, t_sec = [], time.time()
        for j, c in enumerate(chunks):
            t0 = time.time()
            dur = int(est_dur_sec(c) * SR / HOP)
            wave, _ = model.sample(
                mx.expand_dims(audio, 0),
                text=convert_char_to_pinyin([ref_text + " " + c]),
                duration=dur, steps=16, method="rk4", speed=1.0,
                cfg_strength=2.0, sway_sampling_coef=-1.0, seed=seed,
            )
            wave = np.array(wave[ref_n:])
            mx.eval(wave)
            pieces.append(wave)
            rows.append({"engine": "f5", "sec": no, "chunk": j, "text": c,
                         "sec_out": round(len(wave) / SR, 2), "synth_s": round(time.time() - t0, 2)})
            print(f"[f5] sec{no}#{j} {len(wave)/SR:.1f}s in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
        full = np.concatenate(pieces)
        sf.write(out_dir / f"sec{no}_full.wav", full, SR)
        rows.append({"engine": "f5", "sec": no, "chunk": "FULL", "title": title,
                     "sec_out": round(len(full) / SR, 2), "synth_s": round(time.time() - t_sec, 2)})
        print(f"[f5] sec{no} 整节 {len(full)/SR:.1f}s / 耗时 {time.time()-t_sec:.1f}s")
    return rows

# ---------- B 线：GPT-SoVITS（模型只加载一次，交由其内部分句） ----------

def run_gptsovits(sections, ref_wav, ref_text, seed):
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"))
    os.chdir(REPO)
    import numpy as np
    import soundfile as sf
    from GPT_SoVITS.TTS_infer_pack.TTS import TTS, TTS_Config

    print("[gs] 加载模型…")
    cfg = TTS_Config("GPT_SoVITS/configs/tts_infer.yaml")
    print(f"[gs] device: {cfg.device}")
    tts = TTS(cfg)
    tts.init_t2s_weights("GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/gsv-v2final-pretrained/s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    tts.init_vits_weights("GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/gsv-v2final-pretrained/s2G2333k.pth")

    out_dir = OUT_BASE / "gptsovits"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rows = []
    for no, title, text in sections:
        t_sec = time.time()
        gen = tts.run({
            "text": text, "text_lang": "auto",
            "ref_audio_path": str(ref_wav), "prompt_text": ref_text,
            "prompt_lang": "all_zh", "top_k": 15, "top_p": 1.0,
            "temperature": 1.0, "seed": seed,
            "text_split_method": "cut5",   # 按标点切五句，保留口语节奏
            "return_fragment": False, "streaming_mode": False,
        })
        sr, pieces = None, []
        for piece in gen:
            if isinstance(piece, tuple):
                sr, audio = piece
                pieces.append(np.asarray(audio))
        full = np.concatenate(pieces)
        sf.write(out_dir / f"sec{no}_full.wav", full, sr)
        rows.append({"engine": "gptsovits", "sec": no, "chunk": "FULL", "title": title,
                     "sec_out": round(len(full) / sr, 2), "synth_s": round(time.time() - t_sec, 2)})
        print(f"[gs] sec{no} 整节 {len(full)/sr:.1f}s / 耗时 {time.time()-t_sec:.1f}s")
    return rows

# ---------- 主流程 ----------

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--script", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--engine", choices=["f5", "gptsovits", "both"], default="both")
    ap.add_argument("--sections", default=None, help="如 1,3,6；缺省全部")
    ap.add_argument("--ref-f5", default=str(ROOT / "data/test_voice/ref_tingting.wav"))
    ap.add_argument("--ref-gs", default=str(ROOT / "data/test_voice/ref_tingting_short.wav"))
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    sections = parse_script(pathlib.Path(args.script))
    if args.sections:
        keep = {int(x) for x in args.sections.split(",")}
        sections = [s for s in sections if s[0] in keep]
    total_chars = sum(len(t) for _, _, t in sections)
    print(f"解析出 {len(sections)} 节 / {total_chars} 字：")
    for no, title, text in sections:
        print(f"  sec{no} {title}  {len(text)}字")

    all_rows = []
    if args.engine in ("f5", "both"):
        all_rows += run_f5(sections, args.ref_f5,
                           str(pathlib.Path(args.ref_f5).with_suffix(".txt")), args.seed)
    if args.engine in ("gptsovits", "both"):
        ref_text = pathlib.Path(args.ref_gs).with_suffix(".txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        all_rows += run_gptsovits(sections, args.ref_gs, ref_text, args.seed)

    OUT_BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUT_BASE / "chunks.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in all_rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"明细: {OUT_BASE/'chunks.jsonl'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## 跑了什么

用你这份台本（6 节约 1400 字，口语碎片+语气词+中英混码，是很好的压力样本）：B 线 GPT-SoVITS 合成了**全部 6 节**，A 线 F5 合成了 1/3/6 三节做对照。9 个成品全部通过健康检查，在 `voice-lab/data/out/script_test/` 下——`gptsovits/sec1~6_full.wav`、`f5/sec1,3,6_full.wav`，逐段明细（文本/时长/耗时）在 `chunks.jsonl`。用的还是婷婷测试声，产物只是给你做技术评估的。

## 技术发现（这才是这次测试值钱的部分）

1. **速度差距是决定性的**：GPT-SoVITS 全篇 479 秒音频只用 117 秒合成（RTF 0.24，快于实时 4 倍）；F5 是 336 秒合成 215 秒音频（RTF 1.56，慢于实时）。**8 分钟的成品，B 线 2 分钟出完。**零样本试音用 F5 无妨，量产管线主力就是 B 线。

3. **分句机制**：f5-tts-mlx 只认半角标点，中文长段不预切会出事——我在测试器里内置了 `chunk_zh`（按中文句末标点切、50 字打包）；GPT-SoVITS 自带 `cut5` 按标点切五句，对口语节奏的保留更好，这点它做得对。

4. **零样本的天花板**：单一参考音频 = 全篇一个情绪。冷读段的“稳”和“我们今天上菜”的挑逗感是同一个调——这正是计划里阶段 2（分节情绪参考+口癖注入）和阶段 3（呼吸库）要解决的问题，这份稿子把必要性验证得很充分。

- 只做静音切除，**不去呼吸、不去口水音、不做降噪**——这些"不完美"是后续
  微调学口癖、建呼吸库的原料，洗掉就没了。
- 转写（mlx-whisper）是下一步，加 --asr 开关时执行（需先装 mlx-whisper）。

用法：

"""
import argparse, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys

import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf

SR = 24000
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def ffmpeg() -> str:
    import imageio_ffmpeg
    return imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()


def load_mono24(path: pathlib.Path) -> np.ndarray:
    """任意格式 → 24kHz 单声道 float32。"""
    import tempfile, imageio_ffmpeg
    ff = imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as f:
        tmp = f.name
    subprocess.run([ff, "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", str(path),
                    "-ar", str(SR), "-ac", "1", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", tmp], check=True)
    audio, sr = sf.read(tmp, dtype="float32")
    pathlib.Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    assert sr == SR
    return audio


def slicer(audio: np.ndarray, max_len=15.0, min_len=2.0, thr_db=-40.0, win=0.05, gap=0.3):
    """能量切片：按静音段切开，合并短句，截断超长段。返回 [(start_sec, end_sec), ...]。"""
    frame = int(SR * win)
    hop = frame // 2
    hop_sec = hop / SR  # 帧间半重叠：帧 i 的起始时间是 i*hop_sec，不是 i*win
    energy = np.array([
        10 * np.log10(np.mean(audio[i:i + frame] ** 2) + 1e-10)
        for i in range(0, len(audio) - frame, hop)
    ])
    voiced = energy > thr_db
    spans, start = [], None
    for i, v in enumerate(voiced):
        if v and start is None:
            start = i
        elif not v and start is not None:
            spans.append((start, i))
            start = None
    if start is not None:
        spans.append((start, len(voiced)))

    # 合并被 gap 秒以内的静音分开的近邻段
    merged = []
    for s, e in spans:
        if merged and (s - merged[-1][1]) * hop_sec < gap:
            merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], e)
        else:
            merged.append((s, e))

    total_sec = len(audio) / SR
    out = []
    for s, e in merged:
        t0, t1 = s * hop_sec, min(e * hop_sec, total_sec)
        if t1 - t0 < min_len:
            continue
        while t1 - t0 > max_len:  # 超长段硬切
            out.append((t0, t0 + max_len))
            t0 += max_len
        if t1 - t0 >= 1.0:
            out.append((t0, t1))
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--input", required=True, nargs="+")
    ap.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--thr-db", type=float, default=-40.0)
    ap.add_argument("--asr", action="store_true", help="用 mlx-whisper 转写（需已安装）")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    out_dir = ROOT / "data" / "dataset" / args.name
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest = []

    total_in = total_out = 0.0
    for src in args.input:
        src = pathlib.Path(src).expanduser()
        audio = load_mono24(src)
        total_in += len(audio) / SR
        for k, (t0, t1) in enumerate(slicer(audio, thr_db=args.thr_db)):
            clip_path = out_dir / f"{src.stem}_{k:04d}.wav"
            sf.write(clip_path, audio[int(t0 * SR):int(t1 * SR)], SR, subtype="PCM_16")
            manifest.append({"file": clip_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
                             "start": round(t0, 2), "end": round(t1, 2),
                             "duration": round(t1 - t0, 2), "transcript": None})
            total_out += t1 - t0

    with open(out_dir / "clips.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in manifest:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    print(f"输入 {total_in/60:.1f} 分钟 → 切出 {len(manifest)} 条 / {total_out/60:.1f} 分钟"
          f"（丢掉的大多是静音）")
    print(f"清单: {out_dir/'clips.jsonl'}")
    if args.asr:
        sys.exit("TODO: 装 mlx-whisper 后在此接入转写，回填 transcript 字段")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""用 mlx-whisper 给数据集切片回填转写（就地更新 clips.jsonl 的 transcript 字段）。

用法：python scripts/transcribe_dataset.py data/dataset/scorpion
"""
import json, pathlib, sys, time

SR_MODEL = "mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo"

def main():
    d = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "data/dataset/scorpion")
    manifest = d / "clips.jsonl"
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(manifest, encoding="utf-8")]
    todo = [r for r in rows if not r.get("transcript")]
    print(f"{len(rows)} 条，待转写 {len(todo)}")

    import mlx_whisper
    t0 = time.time()
    for i, r in enumerate(todo):
        path = pathlib.Path(r["file"])
        if not path.exists():
            path = pathlib.Path("..") / r["file"]  # 兼容从仓库根 cwd 调用
        res = mlx_whisper.transcribe(str(path), path_or_hf_repo=SR_MODEL, language="zh", fp16=False)
        r["transcript"] = res["text"].strip()
        if (i + 1) % 20 == 0:
            print(f"  {i+1}/{len(todo)}  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    with open(manifest, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"完成 {len(todo)} 条 / {time.time()-t0:.0f}s → {manifest}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""用 mlx-whisper 给数据集切片回填转写（就地更新 clips.jsonl 的 transcript 字段）。

用法：python scripts/transcribe_dataset.py data/dataset/scorpion
"""
import argparse, json, pathlib, sys, time

SR_MODEL = "mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo"

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("dataset", nargs="?", default="data/dataset/scorpion")
    ap.add_argument("--dur-min", type=float, default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--dur-max", type=float, default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    d = pathlib.Path(args.dataset)
    manifest = d / "clips.jsonl"
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(manifest, encoding="utf-8")]
    todo = [r for r in rows if not r.get("transcript")]
    if args.dur_min is not None:
        todo = [r for r in todo if r["duration"] >= args.dur_min]
    if args.dur_max is not None:
        todo = [r for r in todo if r["duration"] <= args.dur_max]
    print(f"{len(rows)} 条，待转写 {len(todo)}")

    import mlx_whisper
    t0 = time.time()
    for i, r in enumerate(todo):
        path = pathlib.Path(r["file"])
        if not path.exists():
            path = pathlib.Path("..") / r["file"]  # 兼容从仓库根 cwd 调用
        res = mlx_whisper.transcribe(str(path), path_or_hf_repo=SR_MODEL, language="zh", fp16=False)
        r["transcript"] = res["text"].strip()
        if (i + 1) % 20 == 0:
            print(f"  {i+1}/{len(todo)}  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    with open(manifest, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"完成 {len(todo)} 条 / {time.time()-t0:.0f}s → {manifest}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 本地 CPU 微调驱动（复刻 webui 流程）。

流程：绝对路径清单 → 1a 文本/BERT → 1b HuBERT+wav32k → 1c 语义 token
     → s2_train(SoVITS 微调) → s1_train(GPT 微调)。顺序执行，全程日志。

用法：python scripts/train_local.py            # 全流程
      python scripts/train_local.py --stage prep   # 只跑预处理三步
"""
import argparse, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time, yaml

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
PRE = REPO / "GPT_SoVITS" / "pretrained_models"
V2 = PRE / "gsv-v2final-pretrained"
EXP = "scorpion"
LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP
VERSION = "v2"

def run(cmd, env=None, stage=""):
    t0 = time.time()
    print(f"\n===== [{stage}] {' '.join(map(str, cmd))}", flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run(list(map(str, cmd)), cwd=REPO, env=env)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print(f"===== [{stage}] exit={r.returncode} 用时 {dt/60:.1f} 分钟", flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"阶段 {stage} 失败，终止")
    return dt

def base_env():
    e = os.environ.copy()
    e.update({
        "version": VERSION, "is_half": "False", "i_part": "0", "all_parts": "1",
        "_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0", "exp_name": EXP,
    })
    return e

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["all", "prep"], default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s2", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s1", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s2", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s1", type=int, default=2)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    # 0) 绝对路径清单（训练脚本在 REPO cwd 下运行，相对路径会断）
    rows = [l.strip().split("|") for l in open(ROOT / "data/dataset/scorpion/scorpion.list", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
    abs_list = LOGS / "scorpion_abs.list"
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(abs_list, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for wav, spk, lang, text in rows:
            f.write(f"{ROOT / wav}|{spk}|{lang}|{text}\n")
    print(f"清单: {len(rows)} 行 → {abs_list}")

    env = base_env()
    env.update({
        "inp_text": str(abs_list),
        "inp_wav_dir": "",
        "opt_dir": str(LOGS),
        "bert_pretrained_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large"),
        "cnhubert_base_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-hubert-base"),
        "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "s2config_path": str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json"),
    })

    # 1a 文本 → phones + BERT 特征
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/1-get-text.py"], env, "1a-text")
    parts = sorted(LOGS.glob("2-name2text-*.txt"))
    merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
    (LOGS / "2-name2text.txt").write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
    for p in parts:
        p.unlink()
    print(f"1a 合并: {len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行")

    # 1b HuBERT 特征 + 32k 重采样
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/2-get-hubert-wav32k.py"], env, "1b-hubert")

    # 1c 语义 token
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/3-get-semantic.py"], env, "1c-semantic")

    if args.stage == "prep":
        return

    # 2B SoVITS 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json") as f:
        s2cfg = json.load(f)
    s2cfg["train"].update({
        "fp16_run": False, "batch_size": args.batch_s2, "epochs": args.epochs_s2,
        "text_low_lr_rate": 0.4, "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "pretrained_s2D": str(V2 / "s2D2333k.pth"), "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_save_every_weights": True, "save_every_epoch": 2, "gpu_numbers": "0",
        "grad_ckpt": False,
    })
    s2cfg["model"]["version"] = VERSION
    s2cfg["data"]["exp_dir"] = s2cfg["s2_ckpt_dir"] = str(LOGS)
    s2cfg["save_weight_dir"] = str(REPO / "logs" / "SoVITS_weights_v2")
    s2cfg["name"] = EXP
    s2cfg["version"] = VERSION
    tmp_s2 = LOGS / "tmp_s2.json"
    tmp_s2.write_text(json.dumps(s2cfg, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s2_train.py", "--config", tmp_s2], env, "s2-sovits")

    # 2C GPT(AR) 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s1longer-v2.yaml") as f:
        s1cfg = yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
    s1cfg["train"].update({
        "precision": "32", "batch_size": args.batch_s1, "epochs": args.epochs_s1,
        "save_every_n_epoch": 1, "if_save_every_weights": True, "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_dpo": False, "half_weights_save_dir": str(REPO / "logs" / "GPT_weights_v2"),
        "exp_name": EXP,
    })
    s1cfg["pretrained_s1"] = str(V2 / "s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    s1cfg["train_semantic_path"] = str(LOGS / "6-name2semantic.tsv")
    s1cfg["train_phoneme_path"] = str(LOGS / "2-name2text.txt")
    s1cfg["output_dir"] = str(LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}")
    env["hz"] = "25hz"
    tmp_s1 = LOGS / "tmp_s1.yaml"
    tmp_s1.write_text(yaml.dump(s1cfg, allow_unicode=True), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s1_train.py", "--config_file", tmp_s1], env, "s1-gpt")

    print("\n训练全部完成。权重位置：")
    print(f"  SoVITS: {REPO}/logs/SoVITS_weights_v2/")
    print(f"  GPT:    {REPO}/logs/GPT_weights_v2/")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The train stages need prep outputs; running --stage all re-runs prep (idempotent but wasteful). Simplest: run --stage all once in background — it does prep then training automatically. But if prep fails early I want to see quickly. Background + early log check works: launch --stage all in background, then poll the log after a couple minutes for stage 1a progress.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 本地 CPU 微调驱动（复刻 webui 流程）。

流程：绝对路径清单 → 1a 文本/BERT → 1b HuBERT+wav32k → 1c 语义 token

REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"

V2 = PRE / "gsv-v2final-pretrained"
EXP = "scorpion"

def run(cmd, env=None, stage=""):

    dt = time.time() - t0
    print(f"===== [{stage}] exit={r.returncode} 用时 {dt/60:.1f} 分钟", flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"阶段 {stage} 失败，终止")
    return dt

def base_env():
    e = os.environ.copy()
    e.update({
        "version": VERSION, "is_half": "False", "i_part": "0", "all_parts": "1",
        "_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0", "exp_name": EXP,
        "PATH": str(ROOT / "venv/bin") + os.pathsep + e.get("PATH", ""),
        "PYTHONPATH": os.pathsep.join(filter(None, [
            str(REPO), str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"), e.get("PYTHONPATH", ""),
        ])),
    })
    return e

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["all", "prep", "train"], default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s2", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s1", type=int, default=15)

    abs_list = LOGS / "scorpion_abs.list"
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(abs_list, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for wav, spk, lang, text in rows:
            f.write(f"{ROOT / wav}|{spk}|{lang}|{text}\n")
    print(f"清单: {len(rows)} 行 → {abs_list}")

    env = base_env()
    env.update({

        "inp_wav_dir": "",
        "opt_dir": str(LOGS),
        "bert_pretrained_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large"),
        "cnhubert_base_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-hubert-base"),
        "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "s2config_path": str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json"),
    })

    # 1a 文本 → phones + BERT 特征
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/1-get-text.py"], env, "1a-text")
    parts = sorted(LOGS.glob("2-name2text-*.txt"))
    merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
    (LOGS / "2-name2text.txt").write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
    for p in parts:
        p.unlink()
    print(f"1a 合并: {len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行")

    # 1b HuBERT 特征 + 32k 重采样
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/2-get-hubert-wav32k.py"], env, "1b-hubert")

    # 1c 语义 token
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/3-get-semantic.py"], env, "1c-semantic")

    if args.stage == "prep":

    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json") as f:
        s2cfg = json.load(f)
    s2cfg["train"].update({
        "fp16_run": False, "batch_size": args.batch_s2, "epochs": args.epochs_s2,
        "text_low_lr_rate": 0.4, "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "pretrained_s2D": str(V2 / "s2D2333k.pth"), "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_save_every_weights": True, "save_every_epoch": 2, "gpu_numbers": "0",
        "grad_ckpt": False,
    })
    s2cfg["model"]["version"] = VERSION
    s2cfg["data"]["exp_dir"] = s2cfg["s2_ckpt_dir"] = str(LOGS)
    s2cfg["save_weight_dir"] = str(REPO / "logs" / "SoVITS_weights_v2")
    s2cfg["name"] = EXP
    s2cfg["version"] = VERSION
    tmp_s2 = LOGS / "tmp_s2.json"
    tmp_s2.write_text(json.dumps(s2cfg, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s2_train.py", "--config", tmp_s2], env, "s2-sovits")

    # 2C GPT(AR) 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s1longer-v2.yaml") as f:
        s1cfg = yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
    s1cfg["train"].update({
        "precision": "32", "batch_size": args.batch_s1, "epochs": args.epochs_s1,
        "save_every_n_epoch": 1, "if_save_every_weights": True, "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_dpo": False, "half_weights_save_dir": str(REPO / "logs" / "GPT_weights_v2"),
        "exp_name": EXP,
    })
    s1cfg["pretrained_s1"] = str(V2 / "s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    s1cfg["train_semantic_path"] = str(LOGS / "6-name2semantic.tsv")
    s1cfg["train_phoneme_path"] = str(LOGS / "2-name2text.txt")
    s1cfg["output_dir"] = str(LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}")
    env["hz"] = "25hz"
    tmp_s1 = LOGS / "tmp_s1.yaml"
    tmp_s1.write_text(yaml.dump(s1cfg, allow_unicode=True), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s1_train.py", "--config_file", tmp_s1], env, "s1-gpt")

    print("\n训练全部完成。权重位置：")
    print(f"  SoVITS: {REPO}/logs/SoVITS_weights_v2/")
    print(f"  GPT:    {REPO}/logs/GPT_weights_v2/")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 本地 CPU 微调驱动（复刻 webui 流程）。

流程：绝对路径清单 → 1a 文本/BERT → 1b HuBERT+wav32k → 1c 语义 token
     → s2_train(SoVITS 微调) → s1_train(GPT 微调)。顺序执行，全程日志。

用法：python scripts/train_local.py            # 全流程
      python scripts/train_local.py --stage prep   # 只跑预处理三步
"""
import argparse, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time, yaml

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
PRE = REPO / "GPT_SoVITS" / "pretrained_models"
V2 = PRE / "gsv-v2final-pretrained"
EXP = "scorpion"
LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP
VERSION = "v2"

def run(cmd, env=None, stage=""):
    t0 = time.time()
    print(f"\n===== [{stage}] {' '.join(map(str, cmd))}", flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *map(str, cmd[1:])], cwd=REPO, env=env)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print(f"===== [{stage}] exit={r.returncode} 用时 {dt/60:.1f} 分钟", flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"阶段 {stage} 失败，终止")
    return dt

def base_env():
    e = os.environ.copy()
    e.update({
        "version": VERSION, "is_half": "False", "i_part": "0", "all_parts": "1",
        "_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0", "exp_name": EXP,
        "PATH": str(ROOT / "venv/bin") + os.pathsep + e.get("PATH", ""),
        "PYTHONPATH": os.pathsep.join(filter(None, [
            str(REPO), str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"), e.get("PYTHONPATH", ""),
        ])),
    })
    return e

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["all", "prep", "train"], default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s2", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s1", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s2", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s1", type=int, default=2)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    # 0) 绝对路径清单（训练脚本在 REPO cwd 下运行，相对路径会断）
    rows = [l.strip().split("|") for l in open(ROOT / "data/dataset/scorpion/scorpion.list", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
    abs_list = LOGS / "scorpion_abs.list"
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(abs_list, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for wav, spk, lang, text in rows:
            f.write(f"{ROOT / wav}|{spk}|{lang}|{text}\n")
    print(f"清单: {len(rows)} 行 → {abs_list}")

    env = base_env()
    env.update({
        "inp_text": str(abs_list),
        "inp_wav_dir": "",
        "opt_dir": str(LOGS),
        "bert_pretrained_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large"),
        "cnhubert_base_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-hubert-base"),
        "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "s2config_path": str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json"),
    })

    if args.stage in ("all", "prep"):
        # 1a 文本 → phones + BERT 特征
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/1-get-text.py"], env, "1a-text")
        parts = sorted(LOGS.glob("2-name2text-*.txt"))
        merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
        (LOGS / "2-name2text.txt").write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
        for p in parts:
            p.unlink()
        print(f"1a 合并: {len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行")

        # 1b HuBERT 特征 + 32k 重采样
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/2-get-hubert-wav32k.py"], env, "1b-hubert")

        # 1c 语义 token
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/3-get-semantic.py"], env, "1c-semantic")

    if args.stage in ("prep",):
        return

    # webui 会建这些存档目录，独立跑要自己建
    (LOGS / f"logs_s2_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / "logs_s1").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 2B SoVITS 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json") as f:
        s2cfg = json.load(f)
    s2cfg["train"].update({
        "fp16_run": False, "batch_size": args.batch_s2, "epochs": args.epochs_s2,
        "text_low_lr_rate": 0.4, "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "pretrained_s2D": str(V2 / "s2D2333k.pth"), "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_save_every_weights": True, "save_every_epoch": 2, "gpu_numbers": "0",
        "grad_ckpt": False,
    })
    s2cfg["model"]["version"] = VERSION
    s2cfg["data"]["exp_dir"] = s2cfg["s2_ckpt_dir"] = str(LOGS)
    s2cfg["save_weight_dir"] = str(REPO / "logs" / "SoVITS_weights_v2")
    s2cfg["name"] = EXP
    s2cfg["version"] = VERSION
    tmp_s2 = LOGS / "tmp_s2.json"
    tmp_s2.write_text(json.dumps(s2cfg, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s2_train.py", "--config", tmp_s2], env, "s2-sovits")

    # 2C GPT(AR) 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s1longer-v2.yaml") as f:
        s1cfg = yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
    s1cfg["train"].update({
        "precision": "32", "batch_size": args.batch_s1, "epochs": args.epochs_s1,
        "save_every_n_epoch": 1, "if_save_every_weights": True, "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_dpo": False, "half_weights_save_dir": str(REPO / "logs" / "GPT_weights_v2"),
        "exp_name": EXP,
    })
    s1cfg["pretrained_s1"] = str(V2 / "s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    s1cfg["train_semantic_path"] = str(LOGS / "6-name2semantic.tsv")
    s1cfg["train_phoneme_path"] = str(LOGS / "2-name2text.txt")
    s1cfg["output_dir"] = str(LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}")
    env["hz"] = "25hz"
    tmp_s1 = LOGS / "tmp_s1.yaml"
    tmp_s1.write_text(yaml.dump(s1cfg, allow_unicode=True), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s1_train.py", "--config_file", tmp_s1], env, "s1-gpt")

    print("\n训练全部完成。权重位置：")
    print(f"  SoVITS: {REPO}/logs/SoVITS_weights_v2/")
    print(f"  GPT:    {REPO}/logs/GPT_weights_v2/")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 本地 CPU 微调驱动（复刻 webui 流程）。

流程：绝对路径清单 → 1a 文本/BERT → 1b HuBERT+wav32k → 1c 语义 token
     → s2_train(SoVITS 微调) → s1_train(GPT 微调)。顺序执行，全程日志。

用法：python scripts/train_local.py            # 全流程
      python scripts/train_local.py --stage prep   # 只跑预处理三步
"""
import argparse, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time, yaml

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
PRE = REPO / "GPT_SoVITS" / "pretrained_models"
V2 = PRE / "gsv-v2final-pretrained"
EXP = "scorpion"
LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP
VERSION = "v2"

def run(cmd, env=None, stage=""):
    t0 = time.time()
    print(f"\n===== [{stage}] {' '.join(map(str, cmd))}", flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *map(str, cmd[1:])], cwd=REPO, env=env)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print(f"===== [{stage}] exit={r.returncode} 用时 {dt/60:.1f} 分钟", flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"阶段 {stage} 失败，终止")
    return dt

def base_env():
    e = os.environ.copy()
    e.update({
        "version": VERSION, "is_half": "False", "i_part": "0", "all_parts": "1",
        "_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0", "exp_name": EXP,
        "PATH": str(ROOT / "venv/bin") + os.pathsep + e.get("PATH", ""),
        "PYTHONPATH": os.pathsep.join(filter(None, [
            str(REPO), str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"), e.get("PYTHONPATH", ""),
        ])),
    })
    return e

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["all", "prep", "train", "s1"], default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s2", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s1", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s2", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s1", type=int, default=2)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    # 0) 绝对路径清单（训练脚本在 REPO cwd 下运行，相对路径会断）
    rows = [l.strip().split("|") for l in open(ROOT / "data/dataset/scorpion/scorpion.list", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
    abs_list = LOGS / "scorpion_abs.list"
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(abs_list, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for wav, spk, lang, text in rows:
            f.write(f"{ROOT / wav}|{spk}|{lang}|{text}\n")
    print(f"清单: {len(rows)} 行 → {abs_list}")

    env = base_env()
    env.update({
        "inp_text": str(abs_list),
        "inp_wav_dir": "",
        "opt_dir": str(LOGS),
        "bert_pretrained_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large"),
        "cnhubert_base_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-hubert-base"),
        "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "s2config_path": str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json"),
    })

    if args.stage in ("all", "prep"):
        # 1a 文本 → phones + BERT 特征
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/1-get-text.py"], env, "1a-text")
        parts = sorted(LOGS.glob("2-name2text-*.txt"))
        merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
        (LOGS / "2-name2text.txt").write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
        for p in parts:
            p.unlink()
        print(f"1a 合并: {len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行")

        # 1b HuBERT 特征 + 32k 重采样
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/2-get-hubert-wav32k.py"], env, "1b-hubert")

        # 1c 语义 token
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/3-get-semantic.py"], env, "1c-semantic")

    if args.stage in ("prep",):
        return

    # webui 会建这些存档目录，独立跑要自己建
    (LOGS / f"logs_s2_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / "logs_s1").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 2B SoVITS 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json") as f:
        s2cfg = json.load(f)
    s2cfg["train"].update({
        "fp16_run": False, "batch_size": args.batch_s2, "epochs": args.epochs_s2,
        "text_low_lr_rate": 0.4, "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "pretrained_s2D": str(V2 / "s2D2333k.pth"), "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_save_every_weights": True, "save_every_epoch": 2, "gpu_numbers": "0",
        "grad_ckpt": False,
    })
    s2cfg["model"]["version"] = VERSION
    s2cfg["data"]["exp_dir"] = s2cfg["s2_ckpt_dir"] = str(LOGS)
    s2cfg["save_weight_dir"] = str(REPO / "logs" / "SoVITS_weights_v2")
    s2cfg["name"] = EXP
    s2cfg["version"] = VERSION
    tmp_s2 = LOGS / "tmp_s2.json"
    tmp_s2.write_text(json.dumps(s2cfg, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s2_train.py", "--config", tmp_s2], env, "s2-sovits")

    # 2C GPT(AR) 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s1longer-v2.yaml") as f:
        s1cfg = yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
    s1cfg["train"].update({
        "precision": "32", "batch_size": args.batch_s1, "epochs": args.epochs_s1,
        "save_every_n_epoch": 1, "if_save_every_weights": True, "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_dpo": False, "half_weights_save_dir": str(REPO / "logs" / "GPT_weights_v2"),
        "exp_name": EXP,
    })
    s1cfg["pretrained_s1"] = str(V2 / "s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    s1cfg["train_semantic_path"] = str(LOGS / "6-name2semantic.tsv")
    s1cfg["train_phoneme_path"] = str(LOGS / "2-name2text.txt")
    s1cfg["output_dir"] = str(LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}")
    env["hz"] = "25hz"
    tmp_s1 = LOGS / "tmp_s1.yaml"
    tmp_s1.write_text(yaml.dump(s1cfg, allow_unicode=True), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s1_train.py", "--config_file", tmp_s1], env, "s1-gpt")

    print("\n训练全部完成。权重位置：")
    print(f"  SoVITS: {REPO}/logs/SoVITS_weights_v2/")
    print(f"  GPT:    {REPO}/logs/GPT_weights_v2/")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 本地 CPU 微调驱动（复刻 webui 流程）。

流程：绝对路径清单 → 1a 文本/BERT → 1b HuBERT+wav32k → 1c 语义 token
     → s2_train(SoVITS 微调) → s1_train(GPT 微调)。顺序执行，全程日志。

用法：python scripts/train_local.py            # 全流程
      python scripts/train_local.py --stage prep   # 只跑预处理三步
"""
import argparse, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time, yaml

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
PRE = REPO / "GPT_SoVITS" / "pretrained_models"
V2 = PRE / "gsv-v2final-pretrained"
EXP = "scorpion"
LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP
VERSION = "v2"

def run(cmd, env=None, stage=""):
    t0 = time.time()
    print(f"\n===== [{stage}] {' '.join(map(str, cmd))}", flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *map(str, cmd[1:])], cwd=REPO, env=env)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print(f"===== [{stage}] exit={r.returncode} 用时 {dt/60:.1f} 分钟", flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"阶段 {stage} 失败，终止")
    return dt

def base_env():
    e = os.environ.copy()
    e.update({
        "version": VERSION, "is_half": "False", "i_part": "0", "all_parts": "1",
        "_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0", "exp_name": EXP,
        "PATH": str(ROOT / "venv/bin") + os.pathsep + e.get("PATH", ""),
        "PYTHONPATH": os.pathsep.join(filter(None, [
            str(REPO), str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"), e.get("PYTHONPATH", ""),
        ])),
    })
    return e

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["all", "prep", "train", "s1"], default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s2", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s1", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s2", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s1", type=int, default=2)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    # 0) 绝对路径清单（训练脚本在 REPO cwd 下运行，相对路径会断）
    rows = [l.strip().split("|") for l in open(ROOT / "data/dataset/scorpion/scorpion.list", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
    abs_list = LOGS / "scorpion_abs.list"
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(abs_list, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for wav, spk, lang, text in rows:
            f.write(f"{ROOT / wav}|{spk}|{lang}|{text}\n")
    print(f"清单: {len(rows)} 行 → {abs_list}")

    env = base_env()
    env.update({
        "inp_text": str(abs_list),
        "inp_wav_dir": "",
        "opt_dir": str(LOGS),
        "bert_pretrained_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large"),
        "cnhubert_base_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-hubert-base"),
        "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "s2config_path": str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json"),
    })

    if args.stage in ("all", "prep"):
        # 1a 文本 → phones + BERT 特征
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/1-get-text.py"], env, "1a-text")
        parts = sorted(LOGS.glob("2-name2text-*.txt"))
        merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
        (LOGS / "2-name2text.txt").write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
        for p in parts:
            p.unlink()
        print(f"1a 合并: {len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行")

        # 1b HuBERT 特征 + 32k 重采样
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/2-get-hubert-wav32k.py"], env, "1b-hubert")

        # 1c 语义 token
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/3-get-semantic.py"], env, "1c-semantic")

    # 合并 1a/1c 的分部分产物（webui 在等待子进程后做合并，独立跑自己来）
    for pat, out_name in (("2-name2text-*.txt", "2-name2text.txt"), ("6-name2semantic-*.tsv", "6-name2semantic.tsv")):
        if not (LOGS / out_name).exists():
            parts = sorted(LOGS.glob(pat))
            if parts:
                merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
                (LOGS / out_name).write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
                print(f"合并 {pat} → {out_name}（{len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行）")

    if args.stage in ("prep",):
        return

    # webui 会建这些存档目录，独立跑要自己建
    (LOGS / f"logs_s2_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / "logs_s1").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 2B SoVITS 微调
    if args.stage in ("all", "train"):
        with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json") as f:
            s2cfg = json.load(f)
        s2cfg["train"].update({
            "fp16_run": False, "batch_size": args.batch_s2, "epochs": args.epochs_s2,
            "text_low_lr_rate": 0.4, "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
            "pretrained_s2D": str(V2 / "s2D2333k.pth"), "if_save_latest": True,
            "if_save_every_weights": True, "save_every_epoch": 2, "gpu_numbers": "0",
            "grad_ckpt": False,
        })
        s2cfg["model"]["version"] = VERSION
        s2cfg["data"]["exp_dir"] = s2cfg["s2_ckpt_dir"] = str(LOGS)
        s2cfg["save_weight_dir"] = str(REPO / "logs" / "SoVITS_weights_v2")
        s2cfg["name"] = EXP
        s2cfg["version"] = VERSION
        tmp_s2 = LOGS / "tmp_s2.json"
        tmp_s2.write_text(json.dumps(s2cfg, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s2_train.py", "--config", tmp_s2], env, "s2-sovits")

    # 2C GPT(AR) 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s1longer-v2.yaml") as f:
        s1cfg = yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
    s1cfg["train"].update({
        "precision": "32", "batch_size": args.batch_s1, "epochs": args.epochs_s1,
        "save_every_n_epoch": 1, "if_save_every_weights": True, "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_dpo": False, "half_weights_save_dir": str(REPO / "logs" / "GPT_weights_v2"),
        "exp_name": EXP,
    })
    s1cfg["pretrained_s1"] = str(V2 / "s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    s1cfg["train_semantic_path"] = str(LOGS / "6-name2semantic.tsv")
    s1cfg["train_phoneme_path"] = str(LOGS / "2-name2text.txt")
    s1cfg["output_dir"] = str(LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}")
    env["hz"] = "25hz"
    tmp_s1 = LOGS / "tmp_s1.yaml"
    tmp_s1.write_text(yaml.dump(s1cfg, allow_unicode=True), encoding="utf-8")
    run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s1_train.py", "--config_file", tmp_s1], env, "s1-gpt")

    print("\n训练全部完成。权重位置：")
    print(f"  SoVITS: {REPO}/logs/SoVITS_weights_v2/")
    print(f"  GPT:    {REPO}/logs/GPT_weights_v2/")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def base_env():

# voice-lab · 音声复刻管线

总计划见 [../音声复刻计划.md](../音声复刻计划.md)。本目录只放可执行的东西。

## 当前状态（2026-10-12 凌晨）

- ✅ **A 线克隆成功**：F5-TTS-MLX 零样本，3 个 seed 出片（`data/out/tingting_clone_seed*.wav`，24kHz，约 19s/条）
- ✅ **B 线克隆成功**：GPT-SoVITS v2 零样本（MPS），3 个 seed 出片（`data/out/gs_tingting_seed*.wav`，32kHz，约 7s/条，**比 A 线快**）
- ✅ **B 线微调成功（本地 CPU 过夜）**：Scorpionnn_ 授权声源，354 切片/67.2 分钟，SoVITS 8 epochs（47.5 分钟）+ GPT 15 epochs（47.8 分钟）
  - 微调权重：`third_party/GPT-SoVITS/logs/GPT_weights_v2/scorpion-e15.ckpt` + `logs/SoVITS_weights_v2/scorpion_ft_e8.pth`
  - **注意**：训练原始 ckpt 缺 `config`/`weight` 键，推理前要转换（注入预训练 config、`model`→`weight`），见 `train_local.py` 后的处理脚本用法
  - 对比样片（同句同参考）：`scorpion_gs_seed*`（零样本）vs `scorpion_ft_seed*`（微调）
- ✅ 数据准备链 v1：`scripts/prep_voice_data.py`（重采样+切片+清单，**故意不去呼吸/不降噪**）
- ✅ 测试声源：`data/test_voice/ref_tingting{,_short}.wav`（本机合成女声，无版权问题）

## 环境复现要点（踩过的坑，重装必读）

- Python 3.11（uv 管理）。关键版本钉：`transformers>=4.51,<5`（5.x 与 peft<0.18 不兼容）、`torch==2.7.1 + torchaudio==2.7.1`（2.8+ 的 torchaudio.load 强依赖 torchcodec，Mac 没有）。
- `f5-tts-mlx` 0.2.6 有个补丁：`venv/.../f5_tts_mlx/cfm.py` 里 `mx.random.normal((..., int(dur)))`（mlx≥0.32 要求 shape 纯 int）。**重装 venv 后要重打**。
- f5 的时长预测器在 mlx 0.32 下输出异常（0.04s），`clone_f5.py` 已改用启发式估时。
- GPT-SoVITS 参考音频限 **3~10 秒**（F5 是 5~15 秒），所以测试声源出了长短两版。
- 手动补下载的模型（不在 requirements 里）：`GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/fast_langdetect/lid.176.bin`（fbaipublicfiles）；`GPT_SoVITS/text/G2PWModel/`（hf-mirror `XXXXRT/GPT-SoVITS-Pretrained` 仓库的 G2PWModel.zip）；NLTK 数据（`averaged_perceptron_tagger_eng`/`cmudict`/`punkt_tab`）；`pyopenjtalk`（text_lang=auto 时混码文本会走到日文模块）。
- 权重下载脚本 `scripts/setup_gptsovits.sh`（hf-mirror，子集：hubert + roberta-large + gsv-v2final，直接落进仓库内 pretrained_models/）。
- ffmpeg 没有走 brew：imageio-ffmpeg 的二进制 symlink 到 `venv/bin/ffmpeg`。
- 推理用 `TTS_infer_pack` 直连（不经 gradio）；`clone_gptsovits.py` 自管 sys.path 和 cwd。

## 台本级测试（2026-10-12，`scripts/synth_script.py`）

用一篇真实风格口播稿（口语碎片/中英混码/语气词密集，~1400 字 6 节）压测两引擎：

- **速度**：GPT-SoVITS RTF **0.24**（全篇 479s 音频 / 117s 合成）；F5 RTF **1.56**（215s 音频 / 336s）。Mac 量产选 B 线。
- **混码**：两引擎对 "OK" 都读成 "O K" 逐字母——阶段 2 需要**英文词转写规则/发音词典**（台本预处理层）。
- **分句**：f5-tts-mlx 只认半角标点，中文长段必须外部预切（`synth_script.py` 内置 `chunk_zh`，50 字/块）；GPT-SoVITS 自带 `cut5` 按标点切句，口语节奏保留更好。
- **零样本局限**：单参考 = 全篇一个情绪，冷读段与高潮段一个调——印证阶段 2（分节情绪参考/口癖注入）与阶段 3（呼吸库）的必要性。
- 产物：`data/out/script_test/{f5,gptsovits}/secN_full.wav` + `chunks.jsonl`（逐段文本/时长/耗时）。

## 硬门槛（再念一遍）

克隆目标只能是：本人 / 书面授权者 / 可商用素材。授权素材到位前，全部用测试声验证管线。

## 快速命令

```bash
# 环境已建好（venv/, Python 3.11）。激活：source venv/bin/activate

# 1. 生成/更新测试参考音频（24kHz 单声道）
python scripts/make_test_voice.py

# 2. 零样本克隆（参考音频 5~15s，--ref-text 必须与参考音频内容一致）
python scripts/clone_f5.py \
  --ref-audio data/test_voice/ref_tingting.wav \
  --ref-text "$(cat data/test_voice/ref_tingting.txt)" \
  --text "要合成的目标台词" \
  --output data/out/take1.wav --seed 1
# 抽卡：换 --seed 2 3 4… 批量生成挑好的；--cfg 2.0 偏稳，调大更贴参考但易炸

# 3. 素材预处理（拿到授权素材后第一步）
python scripts/prep_voice_data.py --input 你的录音.m4a --name target_speaker

# 4. B 线 GPT-SoVITS 安装（已后台跑过的话看日志确认）
bash scripts/setup_gptsovits.sh
```

## 目录约定

- `data/test_voice/` 测试声源；`data/ref/` 授权参考音频；`data/raw/` 原始素材（不入 git）
- `data/dataset/<name>/` 切片+clips.jsonl 清单；`data/out/` 合成产物
- `third_party/` 外部模型与代码（不入 git）；`logs/` 后台任务日志

## 下一步（按计划顺序）

1. F5 零样本冒烟测试通过 → 用授权素材走 `prep_voice_data.py` 建数据集
2. GPT-SoVITS 零样本对比 + 微调（1~5 分钟数据，本地或云 GPU）

|---|---|---|

训练保存的原始权重不能直接推理（缺 `config` 字段、权重键名是 `model` 而不是 `weight`），我从预训练权重里抽出配置注入、按推理格式重写了一份 `scorpion_ft_e8.pth`——这个转换步骤明天可以并进 `train_local.py`，现在手动做完了。

## 老实说的两个已知局限（下一步的抓手）

1. **训练文本没校对**：353 条转写里 whisper 对她的黑话词必有错字，这会轻微污染“字→音”对应——就是之前你没懂的那句话的意思：不是让她读什么，而是她说的音要和正确的字配对，错字会稀释配对质量。用 dictionary/restore 那套纪律过一遍清单，是下一个最划算的质量提升。
2. **数据里可能有 BGM**：切片直接来自视频音轨。如果样片里听出垫乐，跑一遍 demucs 人声分离重建数据集、重训，音色纯度会上一个台阶。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 零样本克隆（B 线主战引擎）。

与 clone_f5.py 同参数风格，便于两条引擎 A/B 对比。
必须在仓库根目录解析相对路径，脚本内部自行处理 cwd 与 sys.path。

用法：
  python scripts/clone_gptsovits.py \
    --ref-audio data/test_voice/ref_tingting.wav \
    --ref-text "$(cat data/test_voice/ref_tingting.txt)" \
    --text "要合成的目标台词" \
    --output data/out/gs_seed1.wav --seed 1
"""
import argparse, os, sys, pathlib, time

REPO = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))                  # GPT_SoVITS/ 包与 tools/
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"))   # AR/ text/ TTS_infer_pack/ 等


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--ref-audio", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--ref-text", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--text", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--gpt", default="GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/gsv-v2final-pretrained/s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    ap.add_argument("--sovits", default="GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/gsv-v2final-pretrained/s2G2333k.pth")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--speed", type=float, default=1.0, help="语速系数，<1 放慢")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    ref_audio_abs = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(args.ref_audio))  # chdir 前先解析
    out_abs = pathlib.Path(os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(args.output)))  # 同上
    os.chdir(REPO)  # tts_infer.yaml 与 G2PWModel 都是相对仓库根的路径

    out_abs.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    import soundfile as sf
    info = sf.info(ref_audio_abs)
    print(f"ref: {info.duration:.2f}s @ {info.samplerate}Hz")

    t0 = time.time()
    from GPT_SoVITS.TTS_infer_pack.TTS import TTS, TTS_Config

    cfg = TTS_Config("GPT_SoVITS/configs/tts_infer.yaml")
    print(f"device: {cfg.device}")
    tts = TTS(cfg)
    tts.init_t2s_weights(args.gpt)
    tts.init_vits_weights(args.sovits)

    gen = tts.run({
        "text": args.text,
        "text_lang": "all_zh",
        "ref_audio_path": ref_audio_abs,
        "prompt_text": args.ref_text,
        "prompt_lang": "all_zh",
        "top_k": args.top_k,
        "top_p": args.top_p,
        "temperature": args.temperature,
        "seed": args.seed,
        "return_fragment": False,
        "streaming_mode": False,
    })
    import numpy as np
    sr, chunks = None, []
    for piece in gen:
        if isinstance(piece, tuple):
            sr, audio = piece
            chunks.append(np.asarray(audio))
    if not chunks:
        sys.exit("没有产出音频")
    full = np.concatenate(chunks)
    sf.write(out_abs, full, sr)
    print(f"ok: {out_abs}  {len(full)/sr:.2f}s  总耗时 {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""素材预处理：重采样 → 能量切片 → 片段清单。

输入：一段或多段原始人声录音（wav/mp3/m4a…）。
输出：data/dataset/<名字>/ 下的 24kHz 单声道切片 + clips.jsonl（时长与序号）。

注意（重要）：
- 只做静音切除，**不去呼吸、不去口水音、不做降噪**——这些"不完美"是后续
  微调学口癖、建呼吸库的原料，洗掉就没了。
- 转写（mlx-whisper）是下一步，加 --asr 开关时执行（需先装 mlx-whisper）。

用法：
  python scripts/prep_voice_data.py --input 原始录音.m4a --name target_speaker
"""
import argparse, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys

import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf

SR = 24000
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def ffmpeg() -> str:
    import imageio_ffmpeg
    return imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()


def load_mono24(path: pathlib.Path) -> np.ndarray:
    """任意格式 → 24kHz 单声道 float32。"""
    import tempfile, imageio_ffmpeg
    ff = imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as f:
        tmp = f.name
    subprocess.run([ff, "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", str(path),
                    "-ar", str(SR), "-ac", "1", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", tmp], check=True)
    audio, sr = sf.read(tmp, dtype="float32")
    pathlib.Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    assert sr == SR
    return audio


def slicer(audio: np.ndarray, max_len=10.0, min_len=2.0, thr_db=-40.0, win=0.05, gap=0.3, v2=True):
    """能量切片 v2：优先在静音/呼吸处断句；超长段在最安静处下刀。

    v1 的问题：短停顿被合并进样本、超长段在语音中间硬切——模型学不到自然停顿。
    """
    frame = int(SR * win)
    hop = frame // 2
    hop_sec = hop / SR  # 帧间半重叠：帧 i 的起始时间是 i*hop_sec
    energy = np.array([
        10 * np.log10(np.mean(audio[i:i + frame] ** 2) + 1e-10)
        for i in range(0, len(audio) - frame, hop)
    ])
    voiced = energy > thr_db
    spans, start = [], None
    for i, v in enumerate(voiced):
        if v and start is None:
            start = i
        elif not v and start is not None:
            spans.append((start, i))
            start = None
    if start is not None:
        spans.append((start, len(voiced)))

    def quietest_cut(s_frame, e_frame):
        """[s,e) 帧区间内最安静的 0.1s 窗口中心（用于在语音中下刀时贴着停顿切）。"""
        w = max(1, int(0.1 / hop_sec))
        seg = energy[s_frame:max(s_frame + w, e_frame - w)]
        if len(seg) == 0:
            return (s_frame + e_frame) // 2
        k = int(np.argmin(seg)) + s_frame
        return k + w // 2

    total_sec = len(audio) / SR
    out = []
    if not v2:
        # —— 旧逻辑（保留对照）——
        merged = []
        for s, e in spans:
            if merged and (s - merged[-1][1]) * hop_sec < gap:
                merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], e)
            else:
                merged.append((s, e))
        for s, e in merged:
            t0, t1 = s * hop_sec, min(e * hop_sec, total_sec)
            if t1 - t0 < min_len:
                continue
            while t1 - t0 > max_len:
                out.append((t0, t0 + max_len))
                t0 += max_len
            if t1 - t0 >= 1.0:
                out.append((t0, t1))
        return out

    # —— v2：静音优先断句 ——
    cut_frames = [s for s, e in spans[1:]]  # 每个语音段的开头都是一次停顿
    boundaries = [0] + cut_frames + [len(voiced)]
    for b0, b1 in zip(boundaries[:-1], boundaries[1:]):
        t0, t1 = b0 * hop_sec, min(b1 * hop_sec, total_sec)
        if t1 - t0 < min_len:
            continue
        while t1 - t0 > max_len:  # 超长段：在最安静处下刀，而不是硬切
            s_f, e_f = int(t0 / hop_sec), int((t0 + max_len) / hop_sec)
            c = quietest_cut(s_f, e_f)
            tc = c * hop_sec
            if tc - t0 < min_len or (t1 is not None and tc <= t0):
                tc = t0 + max_len  # 兜底
            out.append((t0, tc))
            t0 = tc
        if t1 - t0 >= 1.0:
            out.append((t0, t1))
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--input", required=True, nargs="+")
    ap.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--thr-db", type=float, default=-40.0)
    ap.add_argument("--asr", action="store_true", help="用 mlx-whisper 转写（需已安装）")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    out_dir = ROOT / "data" / "dataset" / args.name
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest = []

    total_in = total_out = 0.0
    for src in args.input:
        src = pathlib.Path(src).expanduser()
        audio = load_mono24(src)
        total_in += len(audio) / SR
        for k, (t0, t1) in enumerate(slicer(audio, thr_db=args.thr_db)):
            clip_path = out_dir / f"{src.stem}_{k:04d}.wav"
            sf.write(clip_path, audio[int(t0 * SR):int(t1 * SR)], SR, subtype="PCM_16")
            manifest.append({"file": clip_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
                             "start": round(t0, 2), "end": round(t1, 2),
                             "duration": round(t1 - t0, 2), "transcript": None})
            total_out += t1 - t0

    with open(out_dir / "clips.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in manifest:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    print(f"输入 {total_in/60:.1f} 分钟 → 切出 {len(manifest)} 条 / {total_out/60:.1f} 分钟"
          f"（丢掉的大多是静音）")
    print(f"清单: {out_dir/'clips.jsonl'}")
    if args.asr:
        sys.exit("TODO: 装 mlx-whisper 后在此接入转写，回填 transcript 字段")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 本地 CPU 微调驱动（复刻 webui 流程）。

流程：绝对路径清单 → 1a 文本/BERT → 1b HuBERT+wav32k → 1c 语义 token
     → s2_train(SoVITS 微调) → s1_train(GPT 微调)。顺序执行，全程日志。

用法：python scripts/train_local.py            # 全流程
      python scripts/train_local.py --stage prep   # 只跑预处理三步
"""
import argparse, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time, yaml

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
PRE = REPO / "GPT_SoVITS" / "pretrained_models"
V2 = PRE / "gsv-v2final-pretrained"
EXP = "scorpion"
LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP
VERSION = "v2"

def run(cmd, env=None, stage=""):
    t0 = time.time()
    print(f"\n===== [{stage}] {' '.join(map(str, cmd))}", flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *map(str, cmd[1:])], cwd=REPO, env=env)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print(f"===== [{stage}] exit={r.returncode} 用时 {dt/60:.1f} 分钟", flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"阶段 {stage} 失败，终止")
    return dt

def base_env():
    e = os.environ.copy()
    e.update({
        "version": VERSION, "is_half": "False", "i_part": "0", "all_parts": "1",
        "_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0", "exp_name": EXP,
        "PATH": str(ROOT / "venv/bin") + os.pathsep + e.get("PATH", ""),
        "TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD": "1",  # torch2.7 默认 weights_only=True 会拒载自产 ckpt
        "PYTHONPATH": os.pathsep.join(filter(None, [
            str(REPO), str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"), e.get("PYTHONPATH", ""),
        ])),
    })
    return e

def main():
    global EXP
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["all", "prep", "train", "s1"], default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--exp", default=EXP, help="实验名/数据集目录名")
    ap.add_argument("--list", default=None, help="训练清单路径（缺省 data/dataset/<exp>/<exp>.list）")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s2", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s1", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s2", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s1", type=int, default=2)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    EXP = args.exp

    # 0) 绝对路径清单（训练脚本在 REPO cwd 下运行，相对路径会断）
    list_path = pathlib.Path(args.list) if args.list else ROOT / "data/dataset" / EXP / f"{EXP}.list"
    rows = [l.strip().split("|") for l in open(list_path, encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
    abs_list = LOGS / "scorpion_abs.list"
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(abs_list, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for wav, spk, lang, text in rows:
            f.write(f"{ROOT / wav}|{spk}|{lang}|{text}\n")
    print(f"清单: {len(rows)} 行 → {abs_list}")

    env = base_env()
    env.update({
        "inp_text": str(abs_list),
        "inp_wav_dir": "",
        "opt_dir": str(LOGS),
        "bert_pretrained_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large"),
        "cnhubert_base_dir": str(PRE / "chinese-hubert-base"),
        "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
        "s2config_path": str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json"),
    })

    if args.stage in ("all", "prep"):
        # 1a 文本 → phones + BERT 特征

        merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
        (LOGS / "2-name2text.txt").write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
        for p in parts:
            p.unlink()
        print(f"1a 合并: {len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行")

        # 1b HuBERT 特征 + 32k 重采样
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/2-get-hubert-wav32k.py"], env, "1b-hubert")

        # 1c 语义 token
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/prepare_datasets/3-get-semantic.py"], env, "1c-semantic")

    # 合并 1a/1c 的分部分产物（webui 在等待子进程后做合并，独立跑自己来）
    for pat, out_name in (("2-name2text-*.txt", "2-name2text.txt"), ("6-name2semantic-*.tsv", "6-name2semantic.tsv")):

            parts = sorted(LOGS.glob(pat))
            if parts:
                merged = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip("\n") for p in parts) + "\n"
                (LOGS / out_name).write_text(merged, encoding="utf-8")
                print(f"合并 {pat} → {out_name}（{len(merged.strip().splitlines())} 行）")

    if args.stage in ("prep",):
        return

    # webui 会建这些存档目录，独立跑要自己建
    (LOGS / f"logs_s2_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / "logs_s1").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (REPO / "logs" / "SoVITS_weights_v2").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (REPO / "logs" / "GPT_weights_v2").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 2B SoVITS 微调
    if args.stage in ("all", "train"):
        with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s2.json") as f:
            s2cfg = json.load(f)
        s2cfg["train"].update({
            "fp16_run": False, "batch_size": args.batch_s2, "epochs": args.epochs_s2,
            "text_low_lr_rate": 0.4, "pretrained_s2G": str(V2 / "s2G2333k.pth"),
            "pretrained_s2D": str(V2 / "s2D2333k.pth"), "if_save_latest": True,
            "if_save_every_weights": True, "save_every_epoch": 2, "gpu_numbers": "0",
            "grad_ckpt": False,
        })
        s2cfg["model"]["version"] = VERSION
        s2cfg["data"]["exp_dir"] = s2cfg["s2_ckpt_dir"] = str(LOGS)
        s2cfg["save_weight_dir"] = str(REPO / "logs" / "SoVITS_weights_v2")
        s2cfg["name"] = EXP
        s2cfg["version"] = VERSION
        tmp_s2 = LOGS / "tmp_s2.json"
        tmp_s2.write_text(json.dumps(s2cfg, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        run(["venv/bin/python", "-s", "GPT_SoVITS/s2_train.py", "--config", tmp_s2], env, "s2-sovits")

    # 2C GPT(AR) 微调
    with open(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS/configs/s1longer-v2.yaml") as f:
        s1cfg = yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.FullLoader)
    s1cfg["train"].update({
        "precision": "32", "batch_size": args.batch_s1, "epochs": args.epochs_s1,
        "save_every_n_epoch": 1, "if_save_every_weights": True, "if_save_latest": True,
        "if_dpo": False, "half_weights_save_dir": str(REPO / "logs" / "GPT_weights_v2"),

    s1cfg["train_semantic_path"] = str(LOGS / "6-name2semantic.tsv")
    s1cfg["train_phoneme_path"] = str(LOGS / "2-name2text.txt")
    s1cfg["output_dir"] = str(LOGS / f"logs_s1_{VERSION}")
    env["hz"] = "25hz"
    tmp_s1 = LOGS / "tmp_s1.yaml"
    tmp_s1.write_text(yaml.dump(s1cfg, allow_unicode=True), encoding="utf-8")

Multiple problems, all pointing at one root cause: **the driver used the OLD hardcoded paths despite --exp**. Look:

1. `清单: 857 行 → .../logs/scorpion/scorpion_abs.list` — the abs list went to `logs/scorpion` (EXP global) — that's correct per --exp? No wait: I passed --exp scorpion_v2, but LOGS = REPO/"logs"/EXP is computed at MODULE level from EXP="scorpion"! The `global EXP` assignment in main() happens AFTER module-level constants LOGS/V2/... were bound. LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP evaluated at import time with EXP="scorpion". Setting EXP = args.exp inside main does NOT recompute LOGS. Classic bug.

2. The prep read the list `data/dataset/scorpion_v2/scorpion_v2.list`?? No — it printed "清单: 857 行" — that's the v2 list (857 rows ✓ read from list_path which I did parameterize). But abs list written to LOGS = logs/scorpion (old dir) — mixed state.

3. The wavs referenced in the list are v2 slices (data/dataset/scorpion_v2/*.wav — with names BV1mDpj6QE3m_pNA_0001.wav — same basename pattern as v1!). And s1 crashed with KeyError 'BV1mDpj6QE3m_pNA_0001.wav' — semantic tsv / name2text lookups missing those names — because 1a/1b/1c ran against... hmm, 1a ran on the v2 list (854 merged lines) and wrote 2-name2text.txt into logs/scorpion (old dir, overwriting v1's). 1b output to logs/scorpion/5-wav32k etc. — BUT 1b took 0.6 min for 857 files — too fast! And "vocals_0066.wav Body ... torch.cat() RuntimeError" — that's from 1a processing (BERT feature cat errors). And KeyError on v1 names (BV1mDpj6QE3m_pNA_0001.wav) in s1 — because 6-name2semantic.tsv/2-name2text.txt in logs/scorpion got MERGED from... my merge logic: `if not (LOGS/out_name).exists()` — 2-name2text.txt EXISTS from v1 run → NOT overwritten with v2 merge! So s1 read v1's name2text (v1 clip names) against v2 semantic tsv... wait but where did v2's 6-name2semantic-0.tsv go? 1c ran with opt_dir=logs/scorpion (old) → wrote 6-name2semantic-0.tsv there, but merge skipped because 6-name2semantic.tsv exists from v1! So s1 used v1 name2text + v1 semantic (old v1 names) but the list has v2 names → KeyError. Also 1b hubert: v2 wavs written into logs/scorpion/4-cnhubert and 5-wav32k MIXED with v1 leftovers (same basenames! v1 clip BV1mDpj6QE3m_pNA_0001.wav vs v2 clip with SAME NAME — both datasets have identically-named clips from the same source video!). Fix properly:
1. Make LOGS/REPO-derived constants recompute from EXP: simplest — in main(), after EXP = args.exp, do `global LOGS; LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP`. Make LOGS non-const... it's used in functions via closure/global. Set global LOGS.
2. The merge logic must FORCE-rebuild per experiment: use a fresh exp dir per run — since EXP dir differs (logs/scorpion_v2), no stale files. That alone fixes the merge/collision issue (each experiment gets its own logs/<exp> dir).
3. Clip name collisions between dataset dirs: v1 and v2 clips share basenames (BV1..._pNA_0001.wav) but live in different dataset dirs — fine for GPT-SoVITS as long as the .list has full paths (absolute) and 5-wav32k stores by basename within the exp's own dir. Same basename across DIFFERENT exp dirs = OK.

So the core fix: recompute LOGS from --exp. Then rerun --exp scorpion_v2 --stage all; it'll write fresh logs/scorpion_v2/. Also the partial garbage in logs/scorpion (v2 files mixed into v1 dir) — v1's weights are safe (logs_s2_v2 etc. still there; but 2-name2text.txt got overwritten with v2 content — only matters for future reuse of v1 logs; v1 final weights are saved already, fine).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 本地 CPU 微调驱动（复刻 webui 流程）。

流程：绝对路径清单 → 1a 文本/BERT → 1b HuBERT+wav32k → 1c 语义 token
     → s2_train(SoVITS 微调) → s1_train(GPT 微调)。顺序执行，全程日志。

用法：python scripts/train_local.py            # 全流程
      python scripts/train_local.py --stage prep   # 只跑预处理三步
"""
import argparse, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time, yaml

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO = ROOT / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
PRE = REPO / "GPT_SoVITS" / "pretrained_models"
V2 = PRE / "gsv-v2final-pretrained"
EXP = "scorpion"
LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP
VERSION = "v2"

def run(cmd, env=None, stage=""):
    t0 = time.time()
    print(f"\n===== [{stage}] {' '.join(map(str, cmd))}", flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *map(str, cmd[1:])], cwd=REPO, env=env)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print(f"===== [{stage}] exit={r.returncode} 用时 {dt/60:.1f} 分钟", flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"阶段 {stage} 失败，终止")
    return dt

def base_env():
    e = os.environ.copy()
    e.update({
        "version": VERSION, "is_half": "False", "i_part": "0", "all_parts": "1",
        "_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0", "exp_name": EXP,
        "PATH": str(ROOT / "venv/bin") + os.pathsep + e.get("PATH", ""),
        "TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD": "1",  # torch2.7 默认 weights_only=True 会拒载自产 ckpt
        "PYTHONPATH": os.pathsep.join(filter(None, [
            str(REPO), str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"), e.get("PYTHONPATH", ""),
        ])),
    })
    return e

def main():
    global EXP, LOGS
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--stage", choices=["all", "prep", "train", "s1"], default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--exp", default=EXP, help="实验名/数据集目录名")
    ap.add_argument("--list", default=None, help="训练清单路径（缺省 data/dataset/<exp>/<exp>.list）")
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s2", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs-s1", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s2", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--batch-s1", type=int, default=2)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    EXP = args.exp
    LOGS = REPO / "logs" / EXP  # 必须重算：模块级常量绑定的是默认 exp 的路径

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GPT-SoVITS 零样本克隆（B 线主战引擎）。

与 clone_f5.py 同参数风格，便于两条引擎 A/B 对比。
必须在仓库根目录解析相对路径，脚本内部自行处理 cwd 与 sys.path。

用法：
  python scripts/clone_gptsovits.py \
    --ref-audio data/test_voice/ref_tingting.wav \
    --ref-text "$(cat data/test_voice/ref_tingting.txt)" \
    --text "要合成的目标台词" \
    --output data/out/gs_seed1.wav --seed 1
"""
import argparse, os, sys, pathlib, time

REPO = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "third_party" / "GPT-SoVITS"
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))                  # GPT_SoVITS/ 包与 tools/
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "GPT_SoVITS"))   # AR/ text/ TTS_infer_pack/ 等


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--ref-audio", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--ref-text", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--text", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--gpt", default="GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/gsv-v2final-pretrained/s1bert25hz-5kh-longer-epoch=12-step=369668.ckpt")
    ap.add_argument("--sovits", default="GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/gsv-v2final-pretrained/s2G2333k.pth")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--speed", type=float, default=1.0, help="语速系数，<1 放慢")
    ap.add_argument("--split", default="cut5", help="文本切分法：cut5按标点五句/cut3按中文句号逐句/cut0不切")
    ap.add_argument("--frag", type=float, default=0.3, help="句间插入的静音秒数")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    ref_audio_abs = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(args.ref_audio))  # chdir 前先解析
    out_abs = pathlib.Path(os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(args.output)))  # 同上
    os.chdir(REPO)  # tts_infer.yaml 与 G2PWModel 都是相对仓库根的路径

    out_abs.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    import soundfile as sf
    info = sf.info(ref_audio_abs)
    print(f"ref: {info.duration:.2f}s @ {info.samplerate}Hz")

    t0 = time.time()
    from GPT_SoVITS.TTS_infer_pack.TTS import TTS, TTS_Config

    cfg = TTS_Config("GPT_SoVITS/configs/tts_infer.yaml")
    print(f"device: {cfg.device}")
    tts = TTS(cfg)
    tts.init_t2s_weights(args.gpt)
    tts.init_vits_weights(args.sovits)

    gen = tts.run({
        "text": args.text,
        "text_lang": "all_zh",
        "ref_audio_path": ref_audio_abs,
        "prompt_text": args.ref_text,
        "prompt_lang": "all_zh",
        "top_k": args.top_k,
        "top_p": args.top_p,
        "temperature": args.temperature,
        "speed_factor": args.speed,
        "seed": args.seed,
        "return_fragment": False,
        "streaming_mode": False,
    })
    import numpy as np
    sr, chunks = None, []
    for piece in gen:
        if isinstance(piece, tuple):
            sr, audio = piece
            chunks.append(np.asarray(audio))
    if not chunks:
        sys.exit("没有产出音频")
    full = np.concatenate(chunks)
    sf.write(out_abs, full, sr)
    print(f"ok: {out_abs}  {len(full)/sr:.2f}s  总耗时 {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

- Python 3.11（uv 管理）。关键版本钉：`transformers>=4.51,<5`（5.x 与 peft<0.18 不兼容）、`torch==2.7.1 + torchaudio==2.7.1`（2.8+ 的 torchaudio.load 强依赖 torchcodec，Mac 没有）。

- f5 的时长预测器在 mlx 0.32 下输出异常（0.04s），`clone_f5.py` 已改用启发式估时。
- GPT-SoVITS 参考音频限 **3~10 秒**（F5 是 5~15 秒），所以测试声源出了长短两版。

**定位变更**：声音不锁定为某一声源——现有授权素材只是调参试验台，管线参数才是资产，换基础声音重走 prep→train→synth 即可。

| 档位 | 参数 | 适用 |
|---|---|---|
| 闷/稳 | temp 1.0, top_p 1.0, 慢参考(4字/秒) | 哄睡、平叙述（用户判"虚"） |
| **推荐** | **temp 1.1~1.2, top_p 0.95~0.98, 中速参考(6字/秒,带表态感句式)** | **默认起步档，用户选定方向** |
| 猛 | temp 1.3, top_p 0.98, 中速参考 | 起伏最大，方差大必须多 seed 抽卡 |

- 参考音频选法：完整句、5~9 秒、**按目标演绎状态选语速段**（参考决定整段的劲儿）；
- 机械降速 --speed<1 弃用（伤音质）；停顿靠台本标点密度 + `--split cut3 --frag 0.45`（逐句切分）；
- 高温档抽卡纪律：同文本 ≥3 seed 起步，好 take 入库复用。



用一篇真实风格口播稿（口语碎片/中英混码/语气词密集，~1400 字 6 节）压测两引擎：

- **速度**：GPT-SoVITS RTF **0.24**（全篇 479s 音频 / 117s 合成）；F5 RTF **1.56**（215s 音频 / 336s）。Mac 量产选 B 线。

- **分句**：f5-tts-mlx 只认半角标点，中文长段必须外部预切（`synth_script.py` 内置 `chunk_zh`，50 字/块）；GPT-SoVITS 自带 `cut5` 按标点切句，口语节奏保留更好。
- **零样本局限**：单参考 = 全篇一个情绪，冷读段与高潮段一个调——印证阶段 2（分节情绪参考/口癖注入）与阶段 3（呼吸库）的必要性。
- 产物：`data/out/script_test/{f5,gptsovits}/secN_full.wav` + `chunks.jsonl`（逐段文本/时长/耗时）。

## 硬门槛（再念一遍）

克隆目标只能是：本人 / 书面授权者 / 可商用素材。授权素材到位前，全部用测试声验证管线。

## 快速命令

```bash
# 环境已建好（venv/, Python 3.11）。激活：source venv/bin/activate

# 1. 生成/更新测试参考音频（24kHz 单声道）
python scripts/make_test_voice.py

# 2. 零样本克隆（参考音频 5~15s，--ref-text 必须与参考音频内容一致）
python scripts/clone_f5.py \
  --ref-audio data/test_voice/ref_tingting.wav \
  --ref-text "$(cat data/test_voice/ref_tingting.txt)" \
  --text "要合成的目标台词" \
  --output data/out/take1.wav --seed 1
# 抽卡：换 --seed 2 3 4… 批量生成挑好的；--cfg 2.0 偏稳，调大更贴参考但易炸

# 3. 素材预处理（拿到授权素材后第一步）

# 4. B 线 GPT-SoVITS 安装（已后台跑过的话看日志确认）
bash scripts/setup_gptsovits.sh
```

- `data/test_voice/` 测试声源；`data/ref/` 授权参考音频；`data/raw/` 原始素材（不入 git）
- `data/dataset/<name>/` 切片+clips.jsonl 清单；`data/out/` 合成产物
- `third_party/` 外部模型与代码（不入 git）；`logs/` 后台任务日志

4. 阶段 3：呼吸检测 + 呼吸库（arXiv 2402.00288 思路）

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""口癖画像统计器（阶段 2 第一步）。

从数据集转写里统计一个说话人的"说话指纹"：语气词分布、口头禅、句长节奏、
标点密度、自我修正与重复模式。产出 quirk_profile.json——它是 LLM 台本改写器的
输入（改写器按这份画像把干净台本改造成这个人的口播风格）。

换人设 = 换语料重跑本脚本，管线其余不动。

用法：python scripts/quirk_stats.py data/dataset/scorpion_v2/clips.jsonl
"""
import json, re, sys, pathlib
from collections import Counter

# 语气/口头禅候选表（通用层；赛道黑话不进这里，属于 lexicon 层）
PARTICLES = ["嗯", "啊", "吧", "呢", "哦", "诶", "呀", "嘛", "啦", "哈", "欸"]
PHRASES = ["对吧", "你知道吗", "你知道吧", "就是那种", "说人话就是", "能明白吗",
           "能理解吗", "听懂了吗", "懂的人懂", "大家听", "我跟你说", "怎么说呢",
           "不是……是", "注意啊", "我说的就是", "对，就是", "好，那么", "OK"]

def sentences(text: str):
    return [s for s in re.split(r"[。！？]", text) if s.strip()]

def main():
    path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "data/dataset/scorpion_v2/clips.jsonl")
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(path, encoding="utf-8")]
    texts = [r["transcript"] for r in rows if r.get("transcript")]
    full = "。".join(texts)
    sents = [s for t in texts for s in sentences(t)]

    profile = {
        "语料规模": {"切片数": len(texts), "总字数": len(full), "句数": len(sents)},
        "语气词频次": {},
        "口头禅频次": {},
        "句长节奏": {},
        "标点密度": {},
        "句式习惯": {},
    }

    for p in PARTICLES:
        n = len(re.findall(re.escape(p), full))
        if n:
            profile["语气词频次"][p] = {"次数": n, "千字频次": round(n / len(full) * 1000, 1)}
    profile["语气词频次"] = dict(sorted(profile["语气词频次"].items(),
                                      key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["次数"])[:12])

    for ph in PHRASES:
        pat = re.escape(ph).replace("……", "[^。，？！]{1,12}")
        n = len(re.findall(pat, full))
        if n:
            profile["口头禅频次"][ph] = n
    profile["口头禅频次"] = dict(sorted(profile["口头禅频次"].items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:10])

    lens = [len(s) for s in sents]
    if lens:
        profile["句长节奏"] = {
            "平均句长": round(sum(lens) / len(lens), 1),
            "短句占比(<8字)": f"{sum(1 for l in lens if l < 8)/len(lens)*100:.0f}%",
            "长句占比(>25字)": f"{sum(1 for l in lens if l > 25)/len(lens)*100:.0f}%",
        }
    profile["标点密度"] = {

# 台本口播化改写器 · 提示词模板（阶段 2）

用途：把"干净书面台本"改写成"某个说话人的口播稿"——口癖、停顿节奏、重音记号全部落进文字层。
用法：把本文件 + `quirk_profile.json` + 原始台本交给任何 LLM（换人设 = 换画像文件重跑）。
输出直接送 `synth_script.py` 合成，不再人工润色。

---

## 系统提示词

你是一名口播台本改写器。你会拿到：①一位说话人的语言画像（语气词频次、口头禅、句长节奏、标点密度、句式习惯）；②一篇书面台本。你的任务：把台本改写成这位说话人**会用嘴说出来**的版本。

规则：
1. **语气词按画像频次投放**，不许超频（画像给出千字频次，改写稿的密度对齐它，上下浮动 ±30%）；
2. **句长对齐画像**：平均句长、短句占比都向画像收敛；长句拆短句，用逗号顿出呼吸；
3. **自我修正句式**（"不是X，是Y"）按画像中的频次使用，制造"边想边说"感；
4. **重复即重音**：关键词允许原样重复一遍（"慢慢呼吸，慢慢来"），这是口播的重音记号；
5. 反问/互动语（"对吧""能明白吗"）按画像频次，放在语义确认点，不放在句首；
6. 不添加画像之外的新口头禅，不改变事实内容，不删信息点；
7. 标点即停顿谱：句号=长停，逗号=短停，省略号=拖……句尾问号保留疑问语调；
8. 专有名词、数字不改写。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""呼吸库构建器（阶段 3 · 原型）。

从人声分离后的音轨里检测呼吸段（语音段之间的中能量短促段），切片入库。
分类维度：时长 / 峰值强度 / 有声比（voiced ratio，近似嘶声 vs 声带音）。
用途：给合成结果句界贴呼吸（scripts/splice_breaths.py），库越大越不重复。

用法：python scripts/breath_bank.py <分离人声wav...> --out data/breathbank/scorpion_v2
"""
import argparse, json, pathlib
import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf

SR = 24000

def load_mono24(path):
    import subprocess, tempfile, imageio_ffmpeg
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as f:
        tmp = f.name
    subprocess.run([imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe(), "-y", "-loglevel", "error",
                    "-i", str(path), "-ar", str(SR), "-ac", "1", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", tmp], check=True)
    a, sr = sf.read(tmp, dtype="float32")
    pathlib.Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return a

def find_breaths(audio, win=0.03, speech_db=25.0, breath_db=10.0, floor_pct=20):
    """能量三段法：噪声底 < 呼吸 < 语音。呼吸=位于语音段之间、0.15~0.9s 的中能量段。"""
    frame = int(SR * win)
    n = len(audio) // frame
    e = audio[: n * frame].reshape(n, frame)
    rms = np.sqrt((e ** 2).mean(axis=1)) + 1e-10
    db = 20 * np.log10(rms)
    floor = np.percentile(db, floor_pct)
    speech = floor + speech_db
    breath = floor + breath_db

    voiced = db > speech
    spans, start = [], None
    for i, v in enumerate(voiced):
        if v and start is None:
            start = i
        elif not v and start is not None:
            spans.append((start, i)); start = None
    if start is not None:
        spans.append((start, n))

    out = []
    for (s0, e0), (s1, _) in zip(spans[:-1], spans[1:]):
        gap = db[e0:s1]
        # 呼吸：连续高于呼吸阈值的段
        mask = gap > breath
        j = 0
        while j < len(mask):
            if mask[j]:
                k = j
                while k < len(mask) and mask[k]:
                    k += 1
                dur = (k - j) * win
                if 0.15 <= dur <= 0.9:
                    fs, fe = e0 + j, e0 + k
                    seg = audio[fs * frame: fe * frame]
                    peak_db = db[fs:fe].max() - floor
                    # 有声比：低频能量占比（声带音低频强，纯嘶声平）
                    spec = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg * np.hanning(len(seg))))
                    lo = spec[: len(spec) // 4].sum() + 1e-9
                    vr = float(lo / (spec.sum() + 1e-9))
                    out.append({"start": round(fs * frame / SR, 2),
                                "dur": round(dur, 2), "peak_db": round(float(peak_db), 1),
                                "voiced_ratio": round(vr, 2), "audio": seg})
                j = k
            else:
                j += 1
    return out

def classify(b):
    if b["dur"] < 0.35: L = "短"
    elif b["dur"] < 0.55: L = "中"
    else: L = "长"
    if b["peak_db"] < 16: P = "轻"
    elif b["peak_db"] < 24: P = "中"
    else: P = "深"
    V = "带声" if b["voiced_ratio"] > 0.55 else "嘶声"
    return f"{P}{L}{V}"

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("inputs", nargs="+")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="data/breathbank/scorpion_v2")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    out_dir = pathlib.Path(args.out)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bank, meta = [], []
    for src in args.inputs:
        audio = load_mono24(src)
        bank.extend(find_breaths(audio))
        print(f"{pathlib.Path(src).parent.name}: 累计 {len(bank)} 个呼吸")

    from collections import Counter
    cls = Counter()
    for i, b in enumerate(bank):
        c = classify(b)
        cls[c] += 1
        f = out_dir / f"b{i:04d}_{c}.wav"
        sf.write(f, b["audio"], SR, subtype="PCM_16")
        meta.append({"file": f.name, "cls": c, "dur": b["dur"],
                     "peak_db": b["peak_db"], "voiced_ratio": b["voiced_ratio"],
                     "src": pathlib.Path(args.inputs[0]).parent.name if len(args.inputs) == 1 else "multi"})
    (out_dir / "bank.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\n入库 {len(bank)} 个 → {out_dir}")
    print("分类分布:", dict(cls.most_common()))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        gap = db[e0:s1]
